course_name_original: Gestión, Explotación de Sistemas Eléctricos y Transporte de Energía Eléctrica
course_name_en: Management, Operation of Electrical Systems and Electric Power Transmission
prerequisites: Students should handle concepts like phasor analysis, single and three phase A.C. circuit analysis and real and reactive power.

learning_outcomes.text: To understand the basic features of Spanish and European electricity systems.
To identify the different actors in the electricity market, also understanding their role within it.
To define and evaluate the operating procedures of the Spanish electricity system.
To identify and know the design criteria for the various components involved in a system of electricity transmission.
To estimate and analyse power flows in electric power transmission systems.
To estimate and analyse different types of failures in transmission systems and be able to select and calibrate the different types of protections against them.
To identify and meet the design criteria for the various components involved in a distribution system of electricity.
Identification and understanding the various elements needed to design an electrical system of consumption depending on the type of application.
To estimate load flows, estimates of power and short circuit currents in distribution facilities and power consumption.

assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated as 0.4 x FE + 0.6 x HA. A minimum score of 4/10 must be achieved in the Final Written Exam (FE). Submission of all assigned homework assignments (HA) is mandatory. If minimum requirements are not met, the final grade will be the lower of the calculated grade and 4.0. For the extraordinary call, HA grade is inherited if passed; outstanding tasks can be submitted before the final exam.
